skillset.skill: 8s CT - 2600% Fire DMG (PHY). Increase Paralysis and Freeze RES by 100% during Skill.
skillset.arts: 12000% Fire DMG (PHY). 50% chance to inflict Burn for 10s. For 10s, increase own Skill CT REC by 60%.
skillset.truearts: 20900% Fire DMG (PHY). 100% chance to inflict Burn for 15s. Reset own Hit Count to 0 and increase Allies' Arts by the amount of Hit Count lost.

passive.ability1: Add a Hit Counter that gains Count based on hits to enemies by own Skill, Arts and True Arts. Increase own Movement Speed and Allies' DMG based on Hit Count. Hit Counter caps at 99 hits (DMG increase is approximately 0.5% per hit).
passive.ability3: Increase all Allies' Burn and Freeze RES by 30%. Increase all Allies' Critical Rate by 50% against Burned Enemies. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
